content: {"episode_id":"ep-05163","cpt":"93226","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93226, the 48-hour Holter monitoring study described in the payer letter as not covered under the member's benefit plan. The clinical indication note documents a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia, accompanied by episodes of dizziness and a recent event of syncope. Per that note, the 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management. The submitted diagnosis codes I47.1, R42, and R55 accompany this claim, and we request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 153.07."}
